mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for marble countertop installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe for marble countertops typically involves several stages. After initial consultation and material selection, fabrication can take 2-4 weeks, depending on the complexity of the design and availability of the specific marble slab. The actual on-site installation usually takes 1-2 days. Factors like existing countertop removal, templating accuracy, and the need for custom cuts or unique edge profiles can influence the overall timeline. Hometelligent Inc. prioritizes clear communication throughout this process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Marble countertop installation typically takes 2-4 weeks for fabrication and 1-2 days for on-site installation, influenced by design complexity and material availability.
